notes.title: Update for the 14th of May
notes.content: The current playtest version has been updated to match the demo that will be distributed during the Steam Next Fest. Have fun testing it!

notes.title: Important Update About the Playtest
notes.content:
Thank you for your interest in our playtest! We want to inform you that the game is currently only available in French. An English version is not available at this time.

If you have any questions or want to share your feedback, feel free to join us on Discord -> [url=https://discord.com/invite/D2Qq2ZgJzg]click here[/url]! You’ll find the link on our Steam store page. We’d love to chat with you and hear your thoughts!
